key_points: Diesel defect class certification filed, posing potential legal liability.
Ford and Micron announced a major memory pact, signaling diversification into semiconductors.
EV sales plunged 80% year-over-year in Q3, raising concerns about EV transition.
Ford maintained #3 U.S. sales ranking by beating Hyundai in Q3, showing core market resilience.
Stock showed modest 1% gain on mixed news, indicating limited immediate market reaction.
